assumptions: Repo context = ts/package.json OR .git exists beside npm/ (the issue fix direction). Keyed on markers, never on the missing source itself; .git is a file in a worktree, existsSync covers both.
In-repo missing/unreadable engine source exits 3 (EXIT_ABSTAINED, the doctrine code) and names the full source path on stderr, in both --check and write mode.
Outside a checkout the exit stays 0 but now prints a one-line skipped note on stdout. The published tarball ships no scripts/, so in practice this branch serves only trees with no engine sources.
Drift (1) outranks abstention (3) when mirrors disagree, matching gateOutcome in ts/src/core/gate-result.ts: a finding proves something was checked.
Regression test lives in ts/test (vitest) beside script-entry-guards.test.ts rather than a new npm .test.js, to avoid a new entropy entry point.
